title: Notification inbox (View all) - Switching All / Open / Unread tabs returns the list to the top with matching threads
preconditions: Logged in as a practice user whose notification inbox holds more threads than one page, including some unread and some resolved threads.

steps.action: Click the notification bell, then click 'View all'.
steps.expected_result: The full notification inbox modal opens on the currently selected filter tab.

steps.action: Scroll down the list several screens so that additional threads load.
steps.expected_result: More threads load as you scroll; you are now well below the top of the list.
The list jumps back to the top and shows only unread threads (purple dot). The count matches the unread badge on the bell.
The list is back at the top and shows only open (unresolved) threads.
The list is back at the top and shows all threads, including resolved ones.

steps.action: Scroll to the bottom of the 'All' tab.
steps.expected_result: Older threads keep loading in batches on this tab as well.
